import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Preprocess data to get the count of dogs per district
district_dog_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().reset_index()
district_dog_counts.columns = ['District', 'DogCount']

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=district_dog_counts, x='District', y='DogCount', palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs per District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('District', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
